listing.name: Volantian Reclamation Initiative
listing.summary: The Volantian Reclamation Initiative is the relatively new scion of the fallen Volantian Empire, a long-dead polity that traces its origins back to the first sporeships that reached the Persean Sector, long before the reign of the Domain of Man. The VRI slowly reclaims the husk of their former empire, rapidly growing into a power of the sector and restoring their former heritage. Their liberal use of barely-legal AI and “unsanctioned” privateering and raiding has created several enemies- which the VAF works valiantly to keep at bay-but their openness to trade and collaborate have earned them a sizeable backing from the other polities of the Persean Sector.

description:
By TouchOfVanilla#9615

The Volantian Reclamation Initiative is the relatively new scion of the fallen Volantian Empire, a long-dead polity that traces its origins back to the first sporeships that reached the Persean Sector, long before the reign of the Domain of Man. The VRI slowly reclaims the husk of their former empire, rapidly growing into a power of the sector and restoring their former heritage. Their liberal use of barely-legal AI and “unsanctioned” privateering and raiding has created several enemies- which the VAF works valiantly to keep at bay-but their openness to trade and collaborate have earned them a sizeable backing from the other polities of the Persean Sector.

^///CLICK TO INITIATE TRI-PAD DATA TRANSFER///^

Dependencies: Magiclib, Graphicslib, Lunalib, and Lazylib

What does this mod add?

-A high tech/remnant faction southeast of the core worlds
-Lots of new remnant hulls

Discord

- Version 0.1.0a (Fix crash cause by Kaiken and Phaeton null mount)

- Version 0.1.0 (Released)

New Things In this update!

-Updated for Starsector 0.98a-RC8

-Switched to Java 17

-Added a cool hidden ship to be found out in the sector

-Tweaked some ship and planet descriptions

-Decreased prices of certain volantian hulls

-Removed the sandalphon

-Increased the damage of the azorian lance

-Renamed azorian beam to azorian focuser

-Adjusted descriptions of several weapons

-Nerfed the cressida's mine strike ability

-Decreased intensity of hostile activity fleets

Fixes:

-Fixed the azorian core admin crash

-Fixed VRC re-automation deco slot and crashing issues

April 22nd Hotfix:

-fixed re-automation crashing (again)

July 16th Hotfix:

-Fixed arkship and hostile activity crashing issues for star systems from other mods
